Write a Python function `sum_of_digits(n)` using recursion that returns the sum of the decimal digits of non-negative integer n.

Reply with a single Python code block containing only your function definition(s) (imports allowed if needed). Do not include any example usage, test calls, or print statements of your own -- a separate test harness will be run against your function afterward.
